questions.why: der Stundenplan is the school timetable; das Zeugnis is the report.
bekommen = to get/receive; 'to become' is werden (a false friend).
No article with jobs, and werden goes at the end as an infinitive.

questions.q: Say in German what you did on your last holiday and give one opinion with a reason (2 sentences).
questions.model: Letzten Sommer bin ich mit meiner Familie nach Italien gefahren. Das Wetter war toll, weil die Sonne jeden Tag geschienen hat.
points: perfect tense with correct auxiliary (bin ... gefahren)
opinion with a reason, correct verb position after weil
